statement: For the primitive odd character modulo 4, the source phase image is phi(x)=(1-cos(pi*x/2))/(pi*x/2), and x*phi'(x)=sin(pi*x/2)-phi(x) is not in L². This refutes the derivative estimate in de Roton 2006 Proposition 5.1 (12). More generally, the dilation derivative of the phase image of the indicator is never in L² for any unitary Mellin multiplier.

Under de Roton’s complementary-function L² premise, tested shifts justify the pole-canceled support and two fixed weighted inverse Mellin lines give analytic cutoff jets, Gram limits and target pairings, recovering the lower bound for critical zeros.
